scoring_justification: Checker recomputes the fitted power-law parameter beta and R^2 from the agent's aggregated epsilon_u data and verifies monotonic trends; bending stage is scored with a structural trend check.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden gold values for beta (0.37) and R^2 threshold (0.85) from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper-reported values (beta=0.37, R^2=0.946); R^2 threshold relaxed to 0.85 as per approved plan checker strategy
hidden_assets.generation_method: direct transcription from paper text and approved plan; R^2 threshold set to 0.85 for tolerance
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's published numbers for the same conditions and scale; used as hidden references for scoring proximity and goodness-of-fit.

outputs.description: Aggregated mean strain at UTS for each l/d and t/d condition, used by the checker to recompute the power-law model parameter β and coefficient of determination R².
Surface strain at maximum moment for bending, checked for decreasing ε_s trend with increasing l/d at fixed t/d.

output_contract.notes: The checker will fit the power-law model from step_01_aggregate_data.csv and verify the bending trend from step_02_bending_trend.csv. All outputs are dimensionless; the agent must compute and report values from simulations.

steps.description: Recompute the power-law parameter beta and R^2 from the aggregated tension data, verify monotonic decreasing trend of epsilon_u_bar with l_d for each t_d.
Verify that for at least one fixed t_d, epsilon_s decreases with increasing l_d.
